About Us

Yagyodaya Dudhnath Tharu Multiple Campus (YDMC) is a prominent academic institution situated between Butwal and Bhairahawa, serving as a vital educational hub for students from Suddodhan Rural Municipality, Butwal Sub-Metropolitan City and surrounding municipalities. Established to deliver quality education aligned with national and international standards, the campus proudly embraces its motto: "A Local Institution with Global Standards."

YDMC commenced its academic journey with just 20 students enrolled in B.A. and B.Ed. programs. Today, it stands as a thriving academic community of over 600 students, thanks to the unwavering support of committed educators, social workers, and local stakeholders. In response to growing academic needs, the campus currently offers MBS, BBS, and B.Ed. programs under the affiliation of Tribhuvan University. Recognized for its student-centered teaching and consistent academic achievements, YDTMC has emerged as the first choice for learners in the region. 

The campus was officially QAA-accredited by the University Grants Commission (UGC) Nepal at the QAA Award Ceremony organized by the Educational Quality Assurance and Accreditation Council Secretariat on Sunday, January 26, 2025.
